notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש is throat/breath/life-force, not 'soul'; Tok Pisin discipline uses 'bel' (seat of feeling and thinking).

notes.subject: ol man malolo long bel
notes.rationale: ענוים literally 'depressed/humble ones' — rendered with a Tok Pisin idiom for humility.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Object of 'harim' (the praise) is implicit in Hebrew; Tok Pisin adds bracketed pronoun.

translation: Long Yahwe bel bilong mi i save praesim; ol man malolo long bel bai harim ⟨em⟩ na ol i glad tumas.
